title: Factorization of normalized scalar and exponent coefficient tensors
statement: Let A,B be finite commutative rings, φ:A→B unital, and N>0 annihilate both A and B. Let M annihilate B, and let T be a scheme on which N is invertible. Let t be a root-power, scalar/root-generator and derived-single normalized CoefficientLineComparison from (A,N) to (B,M) [def-pur-finite-smooth-coefficient-arrows]. Let q:mu_N -> mu_M and b:B_T(1;N) ~= B_T(1;M) satisfy FiniteGeneralRingKummerComparison [def-sp-general-ring-canonical-data]. For every d, (t.tensorPower d).hom equals the ordered scalar tensor map VectorTraceScalar.base at exponent N [def-pur-vector-trace-scalar-coefficient-data], followed by finiteGeneralRingLevelPower of b. This includes d=0, empty schemes and zero rings and imposes no flatness hypothesis.

proof.text: N annihilates B by applying φ to its vanishing in A. Take the canonical normalized exponent-change root map q and sheaf line isomorphism b for N to M from etaleFiniteTwistPullback. Its normalization uniquely fixes both maps. The monic root-kernel inclusion identifies q with t.roots. Adjunction injectivity and lineHomEquiv identify t.sheafIso with the common-exponent scalar balancing followed by b, by evaluating the two maps on every scalar/root generator.

Use t.derived_normalization to obtain the same factorization in derived degree zero and after shift. Induct on d: rank zero is the published scalar unit map, and the successor follows by naturality of the tensor bifunctor and functoriality of its two arguments. Thus t.tensorPower is exactly VectorTraceScalar.base at N followed by finiteGeneralRingLevelPower of b. This preserves the ordered shifted tensor presentation without permuting factors.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteCoefficientTensor_factor
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (N M : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hA : (N : A) = 0) (hBN : (N : B) = 0) (hB : (M : B) = 0)
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤)))
    (t : CoefficientLineComparison φ N M hA hB T)
    (q : T.rootsOfUnitySheaf N ⟶ T.rootsOfUnitySheaf M)
    (b : Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine T N B hBN ≅ Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine T M B hB)
    (hb : ProEtale.FiniteGeneralRingKummerComparison B N M hBN hB T q b) (d : ℕ) :
    (t.tensorPower d).hom = VectorTraceScalar.base φ N hN hA hBN T hT d ≫
      (ProEtale.finiteGeneralRingLevelPower B N M hBN hB T b d).hom
